www-7161539.name: Emoji Parkour {23 Levels}
www-7161539.author: _MKR_
www-7161539.description: Welcome everyone on the Emoji Parkour {23 Levels} This is my first best Parkour, the game is with minigames. Objective games: Stars - Collect 30 Stars, and win. Time Attack Flag - Get to this flag in Parkour, show off your best time. Flag - Impregnable, for decoration. Death Match - Defeat players 100 times Eliminate The Oculus - Defeat Oculus 100 times Minigames: PvP - Fight Players on the game and win the Game! Defeat Players 100 times and win the game Oculus - Destroy Oculus on the game and win the Game. Defeat Oculus 100 times and Win, And Collect 1 Star. GameXp - Do you want to get XP quickly? This is a Minigame for you! Cube Gun - Build your House or other things from Cubes. Collect 1 Star GameCoins - Get some money for things. Collect 1 Star Labyrint - A game for tough players in the maze. Collect 1 star Flappy Bird - Do you like to fly Through obstacles? It's a game for you! Collect 1 Star Ninja Run - Be like a Ninja and jump on a distant Platforms or jump over the platform! Collect 1 Star Don't Move - A game where you can not move, sometimes you can move so as not to fall. Collect 1 Star Parkour - Move Levels with obstacles and win the game. Collect 23 Stars. Creator: Orbit1xD ( Polish ) Ognista Uczennica ( Polish )
